::: {.about-subtitle}
Hi! I'm **Olivia Jackson Lambert**, a data scientist and analytics engineer with a background in physics and ML. I enjoy building end-to-end systems that connect data, models, and decision-making.

When I’m not working, I’m usually kayaking, reading, making art, or hanging out with my three cats.
:::

## Highlights

```{=html}
<div class="card-grid">
  <div class="card">
    <h4>Building things end to end</h4>
    <p>I enjoy working across the whole stack, from wrangling messy data to shipping models and building dashboards people rely on.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="card">
    <h4>Thoughtful data foundations</h4>
    <p>I care a lot about clean, well-structured data. I like setting up pipelines and metrics that make analysis easier and more trustworthy down the line.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="card">
    <h4>Comfortable with uncertainty</h4>
    <p>My physics background means I’m used to noisy signals and imperfect data. I focus on understanding what models are really telling us, not just optimizing scores.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="card">
    <h4>Practical problem solving</h4>
    <p>From consulting work, I’m used to open-ended problems, tight timelines, and adapting quickly based on feedback from non-technical stakeholders.</p>
  </div>
</div>
```
